warning: DEVELOPMENT MODEL: trained on whole-animal boxes (one box per photo, labelled healthy / lumpy skin disease / FMD). It does NOT find lesions, and FMD had only 30 training boxes. Not for field use.
output: (1, 4+nc, 8400) float32; boxes cx,cy,w,h normalised 0..1 (the decoder also accepts pixels)
note: Chosen over static INT8 (same 3 MB): INT8 shifted confidence scores by ~0.17 on average in an on-device-pipeline check, FP32 by 0.002, this by 0.005.
